content.summary: Investing.com -- Barclays upgraded Zillow to Equal Weight from Underweight, citing improved execution while challenges in the US housing market persist. Issues around affordability, legal disputes, policy uncertainty, and competition remain unresolved but much of the downside risk now appears priced into the shares.
